Second hand car warranty also misleading in a similar way.

When I purchased my car from a used car dealer, they showed me a warranty card, which convinced me that paying an extra ₹50,000+ was worth it. The warranty provider was MotoXchange.

According to the warranty terms and conditions, the transmission unit and transmission gear for automatic cars were covered. Later, when I visited the service center, they informed me that the ACTR ASSY-MECH needed replacement. Even though this component is directly related to the transmission system, the warranty claim was denied. Their reason was that the document did not specifically mention “ACTR ASSY-MECH,” and since the part is located outside the gear assembly, they considered it excluded from coverage.

The frustrating part is that ACTR ASSY-MECH is essentially the clutch motor, and without it, the AMT transmission system will not function at all.

Frauds are every where.
